summary: David Lund called to report his internet connection is completely dead and experiencing an outage affecting his postcode (3145). The agent confirmed the issue was localized to this area and provided an estimated restoration time of approximately ninety minutes. They then sent him a text message with service updates and credited the downtime, concluding the call as everything was fine for David.

ratings.name: Branding and Survey
ratings.reason: The agent used the correct greeting and offered a post-call survey.

ratings.name: Rapport and Professionalism
ratings.reason: The agent maintained a calm and professional tone despite the customer’s initial complaint.

ratings.name: Probing
ratings.reason: The agent asked clarifying questions like “Is this affecting your internet speed?” to understand the impact of the outage.

ratings.name: Took Ownership
ratings.reason: The agent took responsibility for resolving the issue.

intense.speaker: Client
intense.text: Is there an outage? My connection is completely dead.

suggestions: Confirmation of an ongoing service disruption.
Information about the estimated restoration time.
Verify David’s equipment is functioning correctly.
Confirm the text message will be sent and credit applied.

compliance.name: Discourtesy
compliance.rule: Never be discourteous: no profanity, bashing, impatience, or sarcasm toward the customer

compliance.name: Escalation
compliance.rule: Escalate to a supervisor when the customer asks

compliance.name: Call Avoidance
compliance.rule: Do not avoid the call: never refuse to help or push the customer away without a valid reason

response_times.client_text: Is there an outage? My connection is completely dead.
response_times.agent_text: Let me check that for you straight away.
Can I take your name and postcode to check the right area?
Thank you, David. Yes, there is a reported outage affecting your postcode.

response_times.client_text: Okay, at least it's not just me.
response_times.agent_text: Exactly. The estimated restore time is about ninety minutes.

response_times.client_text: Is there anything I need to do?
response_times.agent_text: Nothing at all, our team is handling it. Your equipment is fine.
I'll send you a text as soon as service is back, and I'll credit the downtime.
Here's the outage reference if you need it. Anything else I can help with?
Thanks for your patience, David, have a good day.
